# LLM Pricing

> Pricing, quality leaderboards and selection tools for 1990+ LLM/chat models across 225 providers. Data from models.dev and Artificial Analysis.

## Overview

- Models: 1990
- Providers: 225
- Provider quotes: 8255
- Data synced: 2026-09-28

## About

LLM Pricing aggregates and normalizes API pricing, capabilities and quality benchmarks for large language / chat models, so you can compare price, capability and every provider's quote in one place.

Methodology:
- Models are merged into canonical entries by normalized name (a model hosted on many providers is one entry with per-provider quotes).
- Blended unit price = input x 0.75 + output x 0.25 (approximate typical usage mix).
- Providers are tiered: first-party (the lab itself), cloud platforms, and third-party gateways. The lowest price is taken from paid channels; $0 channels are listed separately (free tiers usually have rate limits).
- Capability flags are tri-state: supported / unsupported / unknown — never conflated.

## Data sources

- Pricing & capabilities: models.dev (MIT licensed).
- Official video generation pricing: vendor pricing pages (36 models, checked 2026-09-28).
- Quality, coding, agentic, speed & cost-per-task scores: Artificial Analysis.
- Real-world usage (30-day tokens): OpenRouter.
- Data is refreshed regularly (last sync 2026-09-28); prices are indicative — always confirm on each provider's official page.

## Key pages

- [Pricing](https://llmpricing.dev/en/): compare price, capability and every provider's quote for all models
- [Leaderboards](https://llmpricing.dev/en/leaderboards/): intelligence, coding, value, cost per task, speed, usage
- [Value frontier](https://llmpricing.dev/en/frontier/): best intelligence per dollar
- [Providers](https://llmpricing.dev/en/providers/): first-party, cloud and gateway providers
- [Compare](https://llmpricing.dev/en/compare/): 2-4 models side by side
- [Releases](https://llmpricing.dev/en/releases/): a dated feed of recent model releases, each linking to the model's page

## Tools

- [Cost calculator](https://llmpricing.dev/en/tools/cost/): estimate monthly API cost across providers from token usage and cache hit rate
- [Token counter](https://llmpricing.dev/en/tools/token/): exact token counts for OpenAI tokenizers (o200k/cl100k) plus labeled estimates for other models, and per-model cost
- [Subscription vs API](https://llmpricing.dev/en/tools/subscription/): whether an AI subscription beats pay-as-you-go for your usage (ranges, not single points)
- [AI subscription prices](https://llmpricing.dev/en/subscriptions/): consumer plans and quotas for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Copilot and more

## Data & API

Normalized data is published as free static JSON (CC BY 4.0, no key required):
- [Models JSON](https://llmpricing.dev/api/models.json): every model with prices, blended unit price, context, capabilities, quality scores and usage
- [Providers JSON](https://llmpricing.dev/api/providers.json): every provider with tier, model count, SDK and API base
- [API & MCP docs](https://llmpricing.dev/en/api/): field reference, code examples and how to consume the data from an MCP-enabled agent
